extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and new contributors attempting to find or create an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and troubleshooting for locating an existing Wikipedia article or creating a new one (including account requirements, searching for alternative titles, and handling deleted or recently-created pages).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only logged-in, autoconfirmed users can create articles; if you cannot create the page, ensure you have an account and meet the autoconfirmation criteria (or use alternative submission paths such as the article wizard or request page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not autoconfirmed or prefer guided creation, submit a draft via the article wizard or use the request-new-article process so other editors can review and assist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles before creating
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "2014 Charlie Hebdo shooting attack" in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Perform a full-site search to check for alternative titles, spellings, or existing coverage that would make a new article unnecessary or redundant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect inbound links to discover related articles, redirects, or differing titles that cover the same topic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider alternative capitalizations and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the topic exists under a variant capitalization or spelling, either find that page or create a redirect so users searching the other form reach the correct article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delay after recent creation—wait or purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you expect a newly-created page but can't see it, allow time for propagation or use the page purge to refresh cached database responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page was deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an article is missing because it was deleted, consult the deletion log for the rationale and linked discussions; review deletion reasons to guide any revision or appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Troubleshoot missing-article message
rubrics_metrics.description: Other reasons this message may be displayed: (explanatory list including account status, recent creation delays, deletions, capitalization issues).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the suggested troubleshooting steps in order: search for alternatives, verify account/autoconfirmation, check inbound links, consider redirects/capitalization, wait or purge, and consult deletion logs or help pages for why a page might have been removed.
